title: Implement AdminAuditRecord persistence and redacted audit writer
verify: Every successful admin mutation can create a durable AdminAuditRecord
Failed mutations do not create misleading successful audit records
Audit payloads redact secrets/auth material and exclude UI markdown/raw chat
evidence_required: Admin audit persistence and redaction test output
constraints: PostgreSQL/read model is mutable authority for AdminAuditRecord
Before/after summaries contain only bounded non-secret structured fields
Timeline refs may support export/audit but cannot replace durable admin audit
invariants: Every state-changing admin transition is actor-attributed
Raw credentials, tokens, .env values, hidden reasoning, UI markdown, and raw chat are excluded
Archived Plants retain related admin audit records
verification_targets: Audit records are retained after Plant archive and visible only to authorized Boss views
